review_description: Understood the difficulty installing a solar system in my houseChoice of panels in the quote. Efficient organising registering for energy buyback and meter reprogrammingFast installation, tidy work, clean
System has been ordered and approved, installation should take place in February
Paid the deposit and heard very little.......have to pay extra $1000 for an invertor to regulate......Supplier requirements .......very slow in the installation due to lack of required product

Solar Quotes were invaluable in assessing the systems quoted on by the local suppliers recommended by Solar Quotes and  those personally invited to quote.Their assessment reinforced my faith in solar, and eliminated any concerns I may have had relating to brands and performances, enabling me to be better informed to make a decision on the best system for my situation and budget.The system has not been installed at this time, but my experience with the Solar Quotes recommended installer to date has been very cooperative and informative.

I cannot comment about the efficiency and running of the product yet as the house, and therefore the panels are not in use.Sue, the lady I was in contact with gave me a lot of easy to read information about the different components I was about to purchase.The installers were efficient professional and left no mess. (Which is more than I can say about some other tradesmen.)I was continually informed about the process and product.Very satisfied

20.1.15      Initial request for Quotes21.1.15      3 Quotes for various systems3.2.15        Infinity Solar inspected property thoroughly. Discussed best site for Inverter plus panel orientation. Plus fall inspection of meter box and photographed all installation points. Applied to Ergon Energy for permit. They were also very prompt to answer any submitted questions.9.2.15        Infinity Solar came to house to sign contract.  They only required minimal deposit.26.2.15      Installation in conjunction with Ergon Energy; (who were very efficient also). Infinity were very professional installers (They are Company employees. Very neat and tidy installation. Cut over to Grid at 2pm. It all is working well.Will update post of performance in the future.

All the companies that quoted me via the Solar Quotes site were very helpful. The main reason I am using Infinity Solar is due to the site inspection, and their helpfulness. A very close second was Energy Aware, as they helped with the local Power Company.

Although not the cheapest of the three quotes, we found the salesman very thorough in checking out our electricity supply and meters. He did not try and oversell the system by overstating likely electricity generated. Installation was very efficient without any problems, and the system has been running faultlessly since installation.
Ultimately I chose a company who, whilst they were not the cheapest, were both ethical i.e. they didn't try to on-sell and recommended as a quality provider.

Solar Quotes arranged quotes from only two suppliers. Both were helpful but the information from one  conflicted with the info provided by the other, so I felt I needed a third quote. I contacted Infinity Solar in Toowoomba, and they provided a clear explanation and their recommendations were in line with the research I'd done, so I chose them. Their installler was also very professional and provided clear information about the system. They were very prompt, both in quoting and installing. I would recommend including Infinity Solar among your quoters for Toowoomba.
They were efficient and when they had a problem with a part they let us know and fixed it as soon as they could.
I really haven't had the system in long enough to comment on how it's working yet, so far so good
I chose this supplier as they offered European panels rather than made in China even though it was about $1000.00 more expensive
Very Professional, no question left unanswered, Delivery in time frame stated, all paperwork done as promised.

The salesman was all over us to start with and when we signed up. There was an extended delay in having it fitted. He knew what I wanted when he came to do our site inspection then when I insisted he have the tradesmen deliver what I wanted , he turned uncooperative and wanted more payment. He told us he would bring paperwork back after the job and demonstrate, he didn't. I had to follow up the paperwork. The salesman reminds me of an amused car salesman, anything to get the sale and no after sales service. I got the solar hot water system. The tradesman were great , but the salesman I wouldn't recommend.
Found the Solarquotes website to be a very beneficial and informative source of information to learn about solar power.
This was an upgrade of my current 4 kW system. Adding another 8 panels (extra 50%)

Firstly, I have to say that SolarQuotes.com.au was the best thing in my experience in deciding to install a solar system. Everything one needs to know about solar products and installation can be found on this site and Finn Peacock promptly replied to any questions I had to clarify certain points. This saved me a lot of time in my research in this field and ultimately I believe  I have dealt with a good company and got a good product at a good price.Secondly, SolarQuotes provided me with the names of two installers who promptly replied, and one installer who didn't.  I  received quotes from Infinity Solar (Townsville) and True North (Townsville) I went with Infinity Solar for the following reason.  The salesman I dealt with was Dean Delaney who firstly requested a copy of my last power bill from which he calculated my average power usage over the past five quarters and then recommended a 4kW as being suitable in my situation. The price quoted was $11,993.00 No More to Pay for this system which included 17 Solar World x 235w poly panels with a SMA Sunny Boy 4000TL inverter.  The quote overall was very detailed and he even included copies of his own personal power bills which further impressed me. The quote I received from True North was not as detailed and basically only provided prices of it's various size systems and products. It was also about $1,000 more than Infinity Solar for a similar size system. My research on SolarQuotes on the various brands of panels and inverters also swayed me towards the product brands quoted by Infinity Solar.  Dean also answered all of my 28 questions in writing (questions that Finn Peacock suggestsed should be asked) which I put to him to confirm and clarify some matters.  Dean also later made a personal inspection of my premises which is over 100 km from Townsville.  The system was not installed until about ten weeks after the date of contract, however weather conditions played some part in this delay.  ERGON was very prompt with their approval process and the new meter was installed only nine days after the solar installation.  The system is running great and at this stage within my expectations and I have no complaint.  I have given a 4 rating to the above questions as time will only tell if I should have given a 5.  I hope so.

Met with Nick from Infinity Solar late in the afternoon on 9/4. Whilst Nick was here he gave us plenty of advice on things to consider no matter who we went with.  Within a few hours he had supplied us with a full breakdown on costs and expected savings.On the 8/5 I contacted Nick to organise getting the system installed and it is now the 23/5 and the system is installed and was connected to the grid today.  As it is only early I have not had any need to use customer support yet but Nick rang me the day after installation to check how things went and assure me that if I have any questions just to give him a ring.The reason I choose Infinity over the others was there was no hard sell or what appeared to be empty promises just facts, this with the information on SolarQuotes website made the whole process very easy.In regards to the 3 companies I was contacted by through Solar Quotes.One was not interested from the start - did not look at our meter or do measurements to see if panels would fit and became even less interested when he realised that I had no intention of signing a contract there and then no matter what they wanted to offer.One came in all checked everything and full of talk but I felt like it was a lot of empty promises.The third one despite me want them to come out and give a quote and advise emailed a quote to me and I have heard nothing since.

Of the three installers, Mark Group let me down by failing to turn up to give me a quote, and did not return phone calls to reschedule the appointment.  The other two, Halcol & Infinity both had terrific salesmen who where very upfront and knowledgeable.I decided to go with Infinity because they had a slightly better system (in my opinion), and they have their own tradies.  The salesman convinced me to spend a bit more and get a 5kw system instead of a 3kw.  I was skeptical at first but he showed me first hand data from his own 5kw system plus some of his own power bills before and after solar installation and that turned me.  I am very happy with my decision.Infinity solar use their own tradesmen for the installation, who were quick and efficient and did a great job. They were happy for me to stick my nose in ask all sorts of questions about the installation and solar in general.I think I got a great price: 28 x 190w Trina panels and an SMA inverter for $13,250 fully installed. Halcol were very marginally cheaper on a $ per kw basis, but I felt the Trina panels were a bit better than what Halcol were offering.

Finn, your website and the emails you sent out telling me what to look out for were absolutely fantastic.  The comparison chart made me feel better about the products I was choosing between.  I was able to ask the right questions and sent one shonky rep packing.  It is a big investment and your info was really so helpful and so invaluable.  The reputable firms should be giving people your web address because you answer all the important questions. When you don't really know much about the subject it is easy to get a smooth talker to con you into something that is not really necessary or suitable.  Thank you so much for making me feel happily informed about the choices I have made.

I found there was a communication problem . - only communication after initial quote was if I rung them to see what was happening (three times) - plenty of apologies and excuses, but only after a letter did they ring me and keep me in the loop. I hope they`ve learn`t and corrected the hiccup because the result is fine.
Excellent service and installation, but the proof will be in 3 months time when the electricity bill arrives whether I made the right decision, so far so good.
The Infinity Solar Team provided a reliable service and follow-up which has made the installation a pleasant experience.

This was a good all round experience. First of all the information from Solar Quotes was solid gold. Infinity Solar answered all my questions and I felt comfortable when told of delays due to rain. One thing to note, they didn't measure the roof correctly, so when it came time to install they needed an additional tilt kit. As the price was locked in I got this for free. Tilt kits usually cost between $500-$600. I was able to easily research the German manufactured Inverter and Panels and also found test results for the panels from a link on the Solar Quotes website. The other companies had panels that I couldn't find any information on. The workmanship from the three blokes who installed the system was truly impressive. They obviously understand what it means to have the system look good and fittings and fixtures installed correctly. Last but not least. Infinity Solar were the most expensive of three local quotes by approx $500.00.

I left my purchase til the death ie night before the expiry of the 44cent FIT in Qld. I was told installation would likely be not til October so was surprised when installer rang in August ready to go.I think a pre installation visit would have been useful for the installers but after a slight delay Bruno and Amos got into it. Their work was professional and their manner and service friendly. To date no issues just waiting now for energex to install the new meter. The display on the sunny boy inverter is clear and provides both graphical and current status view of usage.
They are a Local Supplier, so I can visit them if there is a problem. They have been in business for over 20 years.
Sad to say, only one of the companies responded and guess what, they got the job.  Because only one responded, I did ring around for other quotes but I still found Infinity to be the best option.
Other two did not contact me so I gained other quotes however decided on infinity as they met all my requirements and could not be of more help, Very satisfied
Infinity Solar are very good to deal with, Energy Australia & SP AUS NET are not so good to deal with still waiting for grid connection after nearly 4 months wait.
All german made system at a good price
This supplier did more than just whack the system in and clear off. They tailored what we needed. Came back immediately to fix something that went awry. Explained things and options to us very well.
Company did both solar power and water seamlessly - top marks!
Quality German products supplied

We are very happy with the service we received from Infinity. Because we have a shade issue in places we had Tigo installed so we could see how each panel was going before we had to trim any trees. It is a comfort to be able to go online and see how each panel is performing.

We had received a quote from another company prior to using the SolarQuotes system. This was as a result of a door-to-door sales approach. This quote was for the same inverter but inferior panels to the quote from Infinity Solar that we accepted but for more than $2000 extra cost. Other quotes received through SolarQuotes referrals were better than the door to door quoting company (whose salesman also told us lies) and the companies responding were all professional and helpful. The information on the SolarQuotes site was also a great help to us in making our decision.
Having a minor hiccup with change of power company, so have not yet seen impact of system on power bill.

We were only contacted by one other supplier and they did not supply off grid installations.  Infinity Solar were quick to reply and came out to go through our needs and discuss what would be required.  This is a large off grid system and quite expensive but cheaper than having mains power connected which also requires further expense.  The system is all top quality parts thus contributing to the high price.  The installer was very professional, particular with his work and very polite.   We have been running off the panels during the day even though the past week we have had monsoonal weather and very little sunlight.  A very satisfying result.  I would recommend Infinity Solar.

The mounting frames had to be modified. The metal shavings as a result of these modifications were scattered over where our children play of which some were quite sharp. We had to clean these all up that took considerable amount of time with more blowing off the roof. Please be cautious of all installers, where they work and how they clean up after themselves. (there was some poor weather whilst the installations were being done)Otherwise from start to finish all went well and I would recommend them again.

From the first phone call to the completion of the solar installation  my INFINITY SOLAR experience  has been a pleasure.  The sales representative was honest open and gave me product information so I could make an informed decision about my selection of panels.  Nothing was too much trouble. They always kept me up to date with the process .  The 2 gentleman who conducted the installation were very polite and professional and they cleaned up after themselves.  I would recommend Infinity Solar NT to anyone who is considering installing solar to their residence or commercial business. What a team!!!!  and I just love being run by the sun.

After much research and already obtaining 3 quotes with varying prices we saw an ad for Infinity Solar. I sent them an email and received a phone call back from their very efficient, approachable and knowledgeable sales person with whom I discussed what I wanted and she emailed me a quote that day with the information about the system. She came around to our house and by that afternoon I had signed the contract. We could have got the system installed about 3 weeks later however as we were going away they arranged to install it a week later. The system has been installed and is working very efficiently. We were very happy with Infinity Solar and would highly recommend them.

The salesperson was a qualified engineer with experience in related fields. He was extremely knowledgable  about available products and used photographic evidence, provided by me, to assist in designing a quality system in what is a very difficult location. The system we are having installed is 3.5kW and unusual because it has east, west and north facing panels. We were in constant contact with each other through out the process by phone and email.

Went with Infinity as they work with Diamond energy to give you 20 c fit above the 8 c govt fit. Also great system, they matched a price for a similar system and had great communication. Fitted within a week of paying deposit. Would reccommend them.

The Electrician and his team were excellent. Very professional, courteous, took great care with setting up and the installation. He explained what he was doing, advised the best place to install the panels and was very safety conscious, checking on his team at all times.He explained how to operate the system and shut down during an emergency or fire.This team are employed by Infinity and are not contractors brought in to do the job. They are well trained and certified tradesmen. We were very satisfied with all aspects of the installation and professionalism of the Electrician and his team. They cleaned up thoroughly after themselves each day and left no mess anywhere. Our sincere thanks to the team.We would thoroughly recommend them to anyone considering investing a P V Solar Energy System.

Andrew White and his Rockhampton team are great.I am very happy with the system and currently produce 24 to 27 kW a day and has done for the last 6 weeks.I completed a lot of research into, not only the installer but also the manufacturers of the solar panels and inverters. I ended up going with 22 x 250w Qcells pro and a Solarmax inverter. Very happy with both, especially the inverter - Swiss made, quiet, not bulky and 10 year warranty.I received quotes ranging from 6k all the way up to 14k, but choose to go with a large, locally based company.  I would not hesitate to recommend Infinity Solar Rockhampton, they are not the cheapest.....But you get what you pay for in this world.
Infinity Solar became our choice as they are a local provider utilizing their own installers. Customer service was second to none and I believe we have received great value for money.

Infinity held our hand (confidence wise) from go to woe. Nothing was left unanswered or in doubt.The installation team contacted us to make prior arrangements for the installation and when the day came it all went without a hitch. The team leader went out of his way to ensure we had a reasonable understanding of procedures and equipment fitted. Follow up calls were made by the company to ensure our satisfaction.As a retired technical person I have absolute confidence in recommending Infinity Solar to anyone considering a solar system purchase and installation.

The sales representative, Erin, was very knowledgeable and understood the solar energy market, she was happy to answer any questions we had, no matter how trivial. The installation team was also fabulous, kemp us updated as to what they were doing, we're happy to stop and answer questions. They arrived early spent the whole day installing the system and cleaned up after themselves... And all on a Saturday! (due to the fact that it was raining all week when the system was to be installed!).We couldn't fault their service, price and commitment to the solar industry!Now if only Energex/Origin could pull their proverbial finger out and change our meter and connect our solar to the grid we would be even happier! (This is NO WAY a reflection on Infinity Solar, as they supplied and processed all the paperwork within days of the system going up, it's the greed of the power companies that have my err!)

All went seamlessly, we got a 4.5 kW System, the most we were allowed. Angel was good to deal with and now we wait for PAWA to connect it to the grid. They did a friend's system in Darwin and it went well.
Good Follow up after sales service.
System is only 1 week old and weather is not the best. I'm waiting to see the results on my power bill

I feel really secure knowing that the system we are getting is going to delivery trouble free electricity to meet our needs in the years ahead.  More importantly, if anything were to go wrong all would be solved with a single phone call.I can not begin to explain the peace of mind that we are getting with this system.  Thank you.

In the painting industry I get to see many peoples houses and some very poor  (untidy) installations. Infinity installed this system very neatly so as to not spoil the street appeal of my property and when finished cleaned up the site. No loose screws were left on the roof or in gutters, this is a problem with many lazy tradesmen. It causes rust.....In summary, nothing was a problem for them.

Knowledgeable, honest sales staff, highly competent installers and good product.The actual output has exceeded their estimate (i.e. their estimate of power production was on the conservative side).5.5kW system comprising 22 Trina 250W panels and SMA SB5000TL inverter.I would use this company again (indeed I have just signed contract for 2nd system).

Salesman could not do enough and passed on the savings to us when the prices dropped he did not have to do that we would not have known. This gave me a sense of trust. If he was unsure of something he kept asking till he got his answer not like some other well known companies who did not even bother getting back to us.

Very professional from start to finish. Very good salesman and they were very friendly and helpful.They weren't the cheapest quote we got but had the answers for any questions we had. They had their own installers not subcontractors.

We received good advice from representatives from both Infinity Solar and the Mark Group.  Both offered the same solar panels and the inverters, while different, both had a solid reputation.  Both companies provided references to installations they had done in the area and feed back from customers I visited was equally positive and the quality of installation were both very good.In the end we went with Infinity because they were more local to us than the Mark Group and tried, from a price point of view, a little bit harder to obtain our business.  For people in our area I would recommend they look at both these companies.The installation of our system was first class and it is working well.
I have found that they don't email information to you when they say they are going to.  Still waiting for receipt from the deposit and the form to update installer for the system for Orgon.
Daniel McCarron was more than helpful and took away doubts we had. Many thanks for your part.

All the sales people presented well and knew their product. Installation date was set for 6 weeks but this has just past so I will need to chase up with the Installers who have probably fallen behind due to long periods of inclement weather.I ended up selecting a local company in case of potential post installation issues with a $500 deposit. Room for negotiation on price as well.System will be Trina 250W panels, Aurora Uno inverter with a Sunlock mounting system.
I used Infinity Solar and they were very good.

Hope I feel the same after the installation and the bills become lower.  Would like to have savings that have the unit all paid for sooner than later as my husband has never been in favour of solar power.  (I know....brain dead at times these men.)

Norman,the sales manager of Gold Coast came around and quoted on  Saturday. He spent time evaluating the best roof position answering all of my questions, telling me how it all worked. He was not the cheapest quote but he gave me the quote based on looking at the roof position, not from google earth images.System was installed when I was out of the country but the guys that did the job were great and fully explained everything they were doing to my wife.All in all I am very happy with the system.
I would recommend these guys again and again!! Adrian Is fabulous (the sales rep).  Cannot tell you in mere words how great this company was to deal with. ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The team at Infinity proved to be very professioanl and the quality of the system was fantastic. I could not praise the installation team enough as the work was done professionally and extremely efficiently. The installation team kept the are tidy and left our home as they found it. I have no hesitation in recomending Infinity to anyone.Infinity may not be the cheapest however, long after the initial pain of the cost fades, the good feeling of quality and long term cost of ownership never goes away.This system wasn't the cheapest, but I am very happy with the purchase and end result.
Excellent service - answered all our questions, showed us their products, met all our needs.
Your company was very helpful and the Rep from Infinity was very through about his product.

The salesmen for Infinity was great, no push or shoving you into the deal because his was "the best on the market". He gave you different ways to go about it, cheap to expensive. He was able to answer all questions we had on the spot, none of this " I will have to get back to you on that". Infinity was also the quickest to respond, other companies I am still waiting for a reply. Not that I will change my mind, I will stay with Infinity.So far so good but the unit has not been installed, so time will tell with backup service.Would and have recommended Infinity to others.
Peter from this company was amazing, patient, professional and was honest, didn't push us into buying with them. The guys who installed were also great.Thanks Finn for answering our questions.

Infinity gave us a very competitive quote and were patient while we collected 2 other quotes. We felt that the salesperson gave us information we needed to make our decision - he was pleased that we had used your service!As soon as we decided to go ahead, it all happened very quickly, easily and trouble free. Electrician was great. It was not an issue that we live "out of town".Very happy with the whole service. Very happy with the system output. Would recommend to others.
Looking forward to a good product from a reputable company but the communication between installer and sales team seems lacking.

The sales rep, Simon Walsh, was extremely helpful and explained everything in a way that was easy to follow and understand. He also called in just after installation to check the job.The installers, Dave & Mathew, were employed by Infinity Solar, not contractors, and were just as helpful with any questions I had for them, and did a great job.I would highly recommend Infinity Solar to anyone considering installing solar electricity.

We ended up installing a slightly more expensive  but quality option, which is performing better than the specifications stated, and should do so for longer.The company was good to work with, provided good advice re: things like removing shading, size of system etc, and the installers were very proficient.Your website gave us good information, recommended three potential installers (which took away a lot of sifting of good versus shonky) and helped us think through the options.It's a shame that there isn't a government feed-in tariff rebate that encourages more people to install solar systems. Even a system based on the current price we buy power from the grid would be sensible and infinitely more earth friendly than fossil fuel generated power.

Currently, not fully installed and connectedQuotes as received through SolarQuotes were informative and had had quality products. However, found them to be less flexible than what I wanted to meet my requirements. Infinity Solar salesperson was informative, enthusiastic and able to answer any question I asked immediately.

Andrew from Infinity in Cairns was the only salesman who did not try to push us into buying a system and what he told us was the same as what we had researched online. The installation team were amazing. Nearly all of my dozens of work mates have gone through Infinity Cairns and I have yet to hear a complaint. I live in Mareeba and my system is pumping out the power and will be for a long time because of the quality system installed. Schott panels and Sunnyboy inverter. Pay for the best and have peace of mind.

At this point in time we have paid our deposit on our system and we are now just waiting for confirmtion as to when our system will be installed.We have been advised by Inifinty Solar that it will be towards the end of March 2011 of early April 2011.Dion and Infinity Solar has been of a great service to us in our purchase of a solar system.  The information and the advice they supplied to us was most helpful and informative in helping us make our decision / the help and advice we have received on the forms to be filled out and the information and requirements of us for the government rebates has been extremely helpful and made the process very easy to cope with.

I did think that I answered an email from you before, saying that I had gone with one of your "offerings". We have not had the system installed yet, mid May they said. The sales person was the only one who followed up with a visit after my inquiry, the others just emailed multiple choices. NOT GOOD ENOUGH.They have had my deposit for 2 months so far, so I do hope they install the goods when the date comes. Just to let you know we went with SMA inverter and SCHOTT panels.If things go "belly up" I will most certainly contact you.RegardsNeil

Installation has not commenced to date. Will occur in June at my request.I obtained a quote from Solarhart which was considerably more expensive.The other people you nominated never showed for the appointment due to mechanical breakdown and never called back for 4 weeks to reschedule appointment.Infinity representative Dean arrived on time, explained everything and has kept in contact regularly.I have taken the lilberty with Dean's approval to recommend him highly to several of my friends who are interested in installing solar.
Excellent. the guys went out of their way to put all the panels in the best location. They were all polite and friendly. Installed the system earlier than they had quoted which was very good.

I did have a company come and talk me into sigining a contract when I really wanted a quote which they do not give. I was upset with myself for letting myself get hoodwinked into that senario and used the 10 day cooling of clause to get out of it.I hope the company I have chosen will do a good job and that it will greatly benifit me in years to come because of the outlay.I will let you know how I got along once the panels are installed and then perhaps you can use my review for your website.

Pleasurable experience and top quality system.From the sales guy to the installers, all were an absolute pleasure to deal with.  They went to great lengths to conceal wiring and make the job look professional.  I opted for brand name German panels and inverter and couldn't be happier.Installation was completed within about 4 weeks.  Panels we ordered were not available so they upgraded us to the next size up in the same Schott brand at no charge, nice bonus.After sales was spot on, with clear documentation and post installation packs and the sales guy even came around to get the free software working and check on everything.ENERGEX meter was installed today so looking forward to cheap power from now on.Compared to other systems I have seen installed at other peoples houses, ours is by far the neatest, most professional and highest quality.  Well done guys, highly recommended.

I only received 1 quote from your guys about 5 weeks after I asked and a few days after I signed with Infinity Solar. It is to be installed in a couple of weeks as I wanted an inverter that is in short supply.
I chose to spend more on a system that offered quality. Infinity offered very good personal service and advice and gave me confidence to support them.
I had no problem in obtaining a discount for being a pensioner, actually they were the only one who offered.
I am very happy with their service, just waiting to see what the results are.
My system is not installed yet but the information and service  in the lead up has been good. It will be installed this month.

Salesman used to work for Ergon and was very knowledgeable about size of system relating to this particular home[ e.g. swer line]. Came highly recommended from a work colleague who was very satisfied with company.
Overall very satisfied. Especially installation workers.
I haven't had it installed yet but so far so good.

The sales Person was very informative of what my needs were and of the best system that I required also about other info for myself to look up and check out before I decided to purchase my Solar system, which others did not do.

I had already signed up for a 5kw system with a crowd that did a "seminar", and was searching for information about solar panels for a friend who did not have the internet.  The more I looked and gained information, I then became disenchanted with the people I had signed up with, after paying them a $1,000 deposit.  When I came across your site, I thought I'll give this a burl and see what comes out of it.I decided that I wanted panels that were fully made in Europe with the parts made in Europe.John, the Boss, from Infinity Solar at Toowoomba contacted me almost immediately.  We had a chat.  From there I received a quote, and then had to try and find finance.  And honestly,  because my husband is one year from retirement age, that was difficult. But it is because of the fact that we'll be on an age pension in the next couple of years, that I wanted to get rid of the power bill, and it also helps with nature, heat etc.  We had to jump through a lot of hoops but managed to get a Solar Loan from a Credit Union.  And that is the only reason that there has been the extended time frame from first accepting the quote to installation.The panels were installed today and the team of two who installed them were knowledgable, professional, and well mannered young men who can truly be proud of themselves.My whole experience with Infinity Solar, Toowoomba has been exceptional.Thank you for your interest Finn, and Thank you for obtaining the quotes.  If you hadn't, Infinity Solar and I would never have had a business transaction.  I also would have paid $1,000 more with the original company I was signed up to.  I cancelled that order under the ten day cooling off period.I must say also, that all of my dealings have been over the internet and phone.Another point is that other companies were a bit long winded in contacting me.
Top quality tradesmen installers.  Prompt response times.  Honest appraisals.  Quality product and Local.

From start to finish this company in Cairns was on the ball. answered all my questions and more.Delivered the goods and at a very competitive price. Installation was quick and neat.So far, very happy I can highly recommend.

Infinity salesman was the only guy to get up on my roof, measure for the best area, and point out shade issues. Some of which I didn't think about until they were pointed out. The installation was very well done. Clean, tidy and very professional. He even ensured my son knew how to isolate the system, then came back again to show me when I was home. Well done Infinity. I would recommend Infinity.
